fields.title: ROCIP search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_searchMode/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). ROCIP's public search API returns full entity detail directly on the search row -- there is no separate/richer detail endpoint -- so every successful record here is one row of the public search result, verbatim from upstream's own field names.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name, number, or surname) that produced this record.

_searchMode.title: Search mode
_searchMode.description: entities, directors, or shareholders -- which ROCIP search index this query ran against.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-ocrs-entitysearch (a real search-result row) or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing) or blocked_or_transient (network/timeout issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

EntityID.title: Internal entity ID
EntityID.description: ROCIP's internal database GUID for this entity (not a public-facing registration number).

EntityName.title: Registered name
EntityName.description: The full registered company or business name on file.

EntityNumber.title: Registration number
EntityNumber.description: The public registration number on the certificate, e.g. '2001/C135' (companies) or '1997/B202' (business firms).

DateOfIncorporation.title: Date of incorporation/registration
DateOfIncorporation.description: Date the entity was incorporated or registered, where on file.

TypeName.title: Legal form
TypeName.description: e.g. 'Private Ordinary Company', 'Private Ordinary Foreign Company', 'Business By Firm', 'Business By Corporation'.

PrincipalOfficeAddress.title: Principal office address
PrincipalOfficeAddress.description: Registered address on file, where recorded.

Email.title: Email
Email.description: Contact email on file, where recorded (usually null in recon samples).

Directors.title: Directors
Directors.description: Comma-separated list of director names on file (order and duplicates as returned upstream).

Shareholders.title: Shareholders
Shareholders.description: Comma-separated list of shareholder names on file. Null on almost every observed record -- ROCIP's public search does not appear to expose shareholder data for most entities.

Secretaries.title: Secretaries
Secretaries.description: Comma-separated list of company secretary names on file, where recorded.

ApplicationId.title: Platform application ID
ApplicationId.description: Internal GUID identifying the registry tenant on ROCIP's shared multi-country e-filing platform. Constant for all Saint Lucia records.

LoweredApplicationName.title: Platform tenant name
LoweredApplicationName.description: Internal lowercase tenant name on the shared platform. Always 'stlucia' for this actor.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for each search-result record.
